root_causes.finding: V42.35 compared a stale blocker file literally with changed files. A blocker stored as '.' for the React component survived a committed vite.config.ts repair.
The saved V35 validation was React green and Rust red, but the event projection and convergence state still identified the old React/Vite failure.
The inherited pre-audit TypeScript fast-recovery pass could change InventoryView.tsx before routing the fresh Cargo failure, creating misleading progress with no lasting accepted-source improvement.
Cargo ran from src-tauri and emitted src\tools.rs and src\models\tool.rs, but generic localization did not reliably convert those paths to project-relative src-tauri paths.
The prior compact failure signature was based on a single file/line/column location, allowing line movement or a different truncated tail to appear like progress.

V42.35 projected node_modules into TypeScript cluster candidates but the generic non-Python candidate clone used for Rust repair replay could still omit the already-green frontend dependency substrate.
